import sys
import bisect

def init(x, l, k, s, c, p, tn, V):
    c[k][l] += 1
    s[k][l][c[k][l]] = (p[0] + 1) - x
    if l == k:
        return
    for i in range(10):
        init(x * 10 + i, l + 1, k, s, c, p, tn, V)

def bf(x, l, n, p, ans, s, c, V):
    if x > n:
        p[0] += 1
        return
    p[0] += 1
    ans[0] = (ans[0] + (p[0] - x) // V - (p[0] < x) + X) % X
    for i in range(10):
        bf(x * 10 + i, l, n, p, ans, s, c, V)

def solve(x, l, n, p, ans, s, c, tn, V):
    if l != 6:
        p[0] += 1
        ans[0] = (ans[0] + (p[0] - x) // V - (p[0] < x) + X) % X
        for i in range(10):
            solve(x * 10 + i, l, n, p, ans, s, c, tn, V)
        return
    if x == n:
        return bf(x, 0, n, p, ans, s, c, V)
    k = 0
    v = x
    while k <= 6 and v <= n:
        v *= 10
        k += 1
    k -= 1
    for i in range(k + 1):
        v = p[0] - 1.0 * x * tn[i]
        ans[0] = (ans[0] + int(1.0 * (v // V - (v < 0) + X) * tn[i])) % X
        v_mod = (v % V + V) % V
        index = bisect.bisect_left(s[k][i][1:tn[i]+1], v_mod)
        ans[0] = (ans[0] + tn[i] - index + 1) % X
        p[0] += tn[i]

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    n_input = input_data
    n = int(n_input)
    tn = [1]
    for _ in range(6):
        tn.append(tn[-1] * 10)
    s = [[[] for _ in range(7)] for _ in range(7)]
    c = [[0]*7 for _ in range(7)]
    p = [0]
    ans = [0]
    p_value = [0]
    for k in range(7):
        init(0, 0, k, s, c, p, tn, X)
        for i in range(k + 1):
            s[k][i][1:tn[i]+1] = sorted(s[k][i][1:tn[i]+1])
    p_value[0] = 0
    if n < 10**6:
        for i in range(1, 10):
            bf(i, 1, n, p, ans, s, c, V)
    else:
        nn = n
        while nn >= 10**6:
            nn //= 10
        for i in range(1, 10):
            solve(i, 1, n, p, ans, s, c, tn, V)
    print((1LL * (X - ans[0]) * V) % X)
